title: Modular Scaffold Crystals for Programmable Installation and Structural Observation of DNA-Binding Proteins
authors: Ethan T. Shields; Caroline K. Slaughter; Fadwa Mekkaoui; Emma N. Magna; Cole Shepherd; Philip S. Lukeman; Donald E. Spratt; Christopher D. Snow
one_liner_zh: 该文开发模块化蛋白-DNA共晶支架，通过DNA编程实现DNA结合蛋白的可控安装与结构观测，虽非TF-DNA特异性结合机制研究，但蛋白-DNA共晶平台对TF-DNA复合物结构解析与界面建模具有重要方法学借鉴价值。
abstract: Inducing biomacromolecules to self-assemble into diffraction-quality crystals remains a major challenge, typically overcome by brute-force experimental screening. Inspired by Seeman’s vision of DNA-junction-based scaffolds organizing guest biomacromolecules, we developed a protein–DNA co-crystal combining modular DNA programmability with robust protein-lattice diffraction. Our engineered co-crystals are composed of stacked double-stranded DNA scaffolded by protein columns, surrounding solvent channels designed to enable guest protein diffusion. DNA ‘strut’ variation allows positionally-controlled installation of diverse DNA binding guest proteins. Experimentally, we simply grow scaffold crystals under standardized conditions, ligate the scaffold, and soak guest proteins. Decoupling crystal growth from guest installation will enable high-throughput structure determination of diverse DNA-binding proteins and protein-macromolecule conjugates. Sub-nanometer position and orientation control of guest macromolecules will also enable functional applications beyond structural biology.
abstract_zh: 诱导生物大分子自组装形成衍射质量晶体仍是一项重大挑战，通常通过暴力实验筛选来克服。受Seeman关于基于DNA连接点的支架组织客体生物大分子构想的启发，我们开发了一种蛋白质–DNA共晶，将模块化DNA可编程性与稳健的蛋白质晶格衍射相结合。我们设计的共晶由堆叠的双链DNA组成，以蛋白质柱为支架，周围环绕设计用于实现客体蛋白质扩散的溶剂通道。DNA“支柱”变异允许位置可控地安装多种DNA结合客体蛋白质。实验上，我们仅在标准化条件下生长支架晶体，连接支架，并浸泡客体蛋白质。将晶体生长与客体安装解耦将实现多种DNA结合蛋白质及蛋白质-大分子偶联物的高通量结构测定。客体大分子的亚纳米位置和取向控制也将实现结构生物学之外的功能应用。
